Author: B.Krishna Mohan
Bench: B.Krishna Mohan
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice B.Krishna Mohan
 Criminal Petition No. 3099 Of 2015
Order:

This criminal petition arises against the Proceedings in CC No.508 of 2007 on the file of the Court of IV Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Dharmavaram, against the Petitioners/A-3 and A-2,
for the alleged violation of Sections 7(i) and 2(ia)(m) punishable under Section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 ( for short "the Act").

entities.text: Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Dharmavaram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri Vivek Chandra, learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the 1st respondent.

The petitioners are shown as A-3 and A-2 and the 2nd respondent herein is shown as A-1 in CC No.508 of 2007 on the file of the Court of IV Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate,
Dharmavaram.

entities.text:
Court of IV Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate,
Dharmavaram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The allegations of the complaint disclose that on 31.07.2006 at about 1.00 p.m. the 1st respondent along with his staff had inspected 'Mysore Bakery', at which time, the 2nd respondent/A-1 was present at the shop.

During the course of inspection, the 1st respondent found 2 cartons and each carton containing 15 kgs. box of 'New Aadhar Bake Well Interesterfied Vegetable Oil' along with sweets, mixure etc., which were meant for sale for human consumption.

On 01.08.2006 the 1st respondent after collecting the samples, divided the said vegetable oil into three parts and sent one part to the Public Analyst, State Food Laboratory, Hyderabad, and entrusted the remaining two parts to the local authorities of Anantapur for preservation.

Subsequently, the Public Analyst sent the report dated 07.09.2006 opining that the sample does not confirm to the standards of Red Units in respect of Sesame Oil and reported that the product is adulterated as per Section 2(ia) (m) of the Act, 1954.
Basing upon the same, the 1st respondent gave complaint on 28.08.2007 against the petitioners/A-3 and A-2 and the 2nd respondent/A-1 for the offences stated above.

After filing the charge sheet, the learned IV Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Dharmavaram, took cognizance of the case and numbered the case as CC No.508 of 2017 and issued notices to the accused.

entities.text: Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Dharmavaram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the proceedings in the above CC cannot be continued since Section 13(2) of the Act contemplates that ten days time would be there for the petitioners to seek for sending the products for further analysis to the Central Food M/S. Acalmar Oils Fats Ltd., E.G.Dist. ... vs Food Inspector, Anantahpur Ano on 24 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49244288/
1 Laboratory.

entities.text: Central Food M/S. Acalmar Oils Fats Ltd., E.G.Dist. ... vs Food Inspector, Anantahpur Ano
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also brought to the notice of this Court that the life time of the product was expired by the time of filing complaint i.e., 28.08.2007.
In view of the same, continuation of the proceedings against the petitioners would amount to abuse of process of law.

In support of his contention, he relied upon the order dated 05.10.2018, passed in Crl.P.No.4300 of 2011, wherein, similar circumstances were dealt with by this Court and ultimately the Proceedings therein were quashed against the petitioners therein by allowing the said criminal petition.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and in the light of the order dated 05.10.2018, passed in Crl.P.No.4300 of 2011 by this Court, the Proceedings against the petitioners in CC No.508 of 2007, cannot be allowed to be continued as the product's life was already expired by 31.01.2007 and the opportunity of the petitioners was lost under Section 13(2) of the Act.
In view of the same, it is futile to hold the Proceedings against the petitioners/A-3 and A-2 in CC No.508 of 2007.

Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the Proceedings in CC No.508 of 2007 on the file of the Court of IV Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Dharmavaram, against the Petitioners/A-3 and A-2, are quashed.

entities.text: Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Dharmavaram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.
